content: {"episode_id":"ep-05199","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of mobile cardiac telemetry, CPT 93229, for which required prior authorization was not obtained. The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia in the context of a recent transient cerebral ischemic attack. Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture the underlying rhythm during symptomatic events and to evaluate for potential arrhythmic triggers contributing to the cerebrovascular symptoms."}
